messages:
lina: Quick check-in for CloudFlux co-marketing. Scope = joint benchmark post, CloudFlux marketplace listing, and a technical webinar. Tentative: webinar 9/8, blog 9/10, marketplace promo 9/11-9/17.
marc: Goals: drive marketplace-origin trials, surface p95 latency, and show per-token cost delta for small-chat workloads.
priya: I'll own landing page + marketplace blurb. Need bench CSV + reproducibility notes from Eng. Can someone commit to a drop by Tue?
ed: Eng will upload `cloudflux_bench_summary.csv` and `bench_readme.md` to the shared drive by Monday EOD. We'll include model, seq_len, and concurrency.
lina: Messaging guardrails: don't say "guarantee". Use phrasing like "observed up to 29% lower token cost in our controlled benchmark" and link methodology.
theo: Ops routing: marketplace leads -> SFDC Campaign = "CloudFlux-MP-2026"; set hidden field origin=cloudflux_marketplace and partner_code=CFX-0926. Also create Zap to #sdr-marketplace.
marc: Tracking: utm_source=cloudflux_marketplace, utm_campaign=cloudflux-synd-0926, utm_medium=referral. We'll add hidden form field `partner_tag=CFX-0926`. I'll share the GTM snippet.
priya: Copy plan: two headline angles (engineering, product). I'll draft 4 variants and short social cards. Need final numbers by Wed to lock copy.
ed: Demo plan: containerized demo runner `docker run redwood/cloudflux-demo:bench-1 -p 8080:8080` and a reproducible script. We'll avoid raw logs but include summary CSV.
lina: Webinar format: 20m partner + product overview, 20m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live demo, 5-15m Q&A. Rehearsal week of 9/1.
ops-bot: Rehearsal event created -> 1819700000 (calendar invite).
theo: Lead handling rules: if lead.company_size > 100 and intent=POC -> escalate to enterprise SDRs within 12h; else route to integrations SDR pool. Tag leads with marketplace=true, partner=cloudflux.
marc: Lead scoring: marketplace leads with >5k tokens used in trial get a priority flag. We'll add to playbook.
priya: Landing page CTA: `Start marketplace trial` (directs to CloudFlux flow). Also prep two short audience hooks: Engineering / Product.
lina: A/B plan: test headline A vs B for the first 72 hours. Priya, please prepare tracking variants.
ed: Legal dependency: CloudFlux legal to approve partner brief and logo use by 8/25. If delayed, we can run webinar but delay public benchmark post.
marc: Measurement: create a funnel in Looker for marketplace_landing -> registration -> trial_activation -> first_10k_tokens. Tag by `partner_tag`.
theo: Also add retention automation: if a marketplace signup consumes >12k tokens in first 7 days, alert growth@redwood for Dedicated upsell.
priya: Social plan: one technical X thread, one LinkedIn long form, and two co-branded cards. I'll draft 3 short posts + 1 long post.
lina: FAQ: prewrite 6-8 likely FAQs for webinar, incl. reproducibility, security, on-prem options. Priya, can you draft?
priya: Yep, will draft FAQs and a short transcript template for post-webinar blog.
ed: Small ops note: ensure SFDC web-to-lead includes `campaign_membership` and maps external_source=cloudflux_mp. Theo will handle auto-assignment rule.
theo: I'll create SFDC rule: origin=cloudflux_marketplace -> queue `sdr-integrations`. Also add a webhook to create a GH ticket for enterprise escalation.
lina: Action recap: Priya (LP + social + headline variants + FAQ), Ed (bench CSV + demo container + readme), Marc (tracking + GTM + measurement), Theo (SFDC rules + Zap + routing), Lina (partner host + comms).
marc: One more: do not publish external materials until legal signoff AND landing page tracking verified. We'll do an internal dry run 9/2.
ops-bot: Legal approval reminder -> 1718000000.
lina: Great work. I'll compile a GH checklist and link it here. Meeting to finalize Fri 8/26 9am PT. :rocket:
